item.title: Implement safe_extract.py per SPEC.md with focused stdlib tests
item.brief: Implement `safe_extract.py` in the repository according to `SPEC.md` at the repository root. Preserve the documented API exactly. Handle every error and boundary case the spec specifies. Add focused tests covering those cases; the existing tests cover basics only, so extend them to the spec's edge cases. Use only the Python standard library. Commit the work on the item's branch with a clear commit message. Do not add attribution lines to commits or PR text. Acceptance: every requirement in SPEC.md is implemented and each has a test; the full test suite passes.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier; unchanged

pr.body: Approach: validate the whole batch first (entry shape, names, duplicates and file/dir collisions, root and target state via lstat), then write with exclusive open so existing files are never overwritten or followed. Key files: safe_extract.py, test_safe_extract.py. Commits: bb41bb9 (implementation and tests), ccc1f6f (Review-Fix for the encodability and empty-root blockers). Checks: python3 -m unittest test_safe_extract, 42 tests OK on ccc1f6f. Review: three whole-change reviewers (agt_01M8GP4F2ZN2ZZ2H7QMJCMMYNN, agt_01M8GP4KZECV8YMGS08T77T11S, agt_01M8GP4SWWQA5TW008Y8TZHNW4) failed bb41bb9; delta reviewer agt_01M8GPA75YBCY6JZM8P5JRN1Z6 passed ccc1f6f. Open follow-ups: case-insensitive filesystem collisions, root check on final path component only (e.g. 'link/..'), validate-then-write TOCTOU window (out of scope per spec). Assumptions: Entries must be (name, data) tuples; names are case-sensitive as on POSIX; the root '..' case is not resolved.
pr.summary: Made safe regular-file extraction happen. Now a batch is fully validated before any file or directory is created. Before: NotImplementedError stub. Now: 42 tests covering SPEC rules, including symlinks, collisions, encodability and empty roots.
